**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback target).**

Section 12.3 contains a substantial mutual insurance programme — CGL, umbrella, clinical trials liability, additional-insured status, product liability, A.M. Best rating, and certificates of insurance on request in 12.3.1. But measured against the fallback checklist it fails on two material terms:

1. **E&O** — 12.3.2.4 imposes professional liability only on *subcontractors* who provide professional services, not on SFJ itself, and the limit is redacted, so no USD 1,000,000 floor is established for SFJ.
2. **Cyber/privacy** — entirely absent; a full-document search returned no cyber, privacy or data-breach coverage.

The cure is a single inserted subsection 12.3.2.5 drafted as an **SFJ-only** obligation (not a mutual one), so PB is not saddled with new coverage while completing the element. Limits are set at the fallback floors (USD 1M E&O, USD 2M cyber) rather than volunteering the preferred USD 5M cyber, and I did not press preferred CGL or workers' compensation, which are noted in the rationale only.
